what_to_detect: Two or more battle cry trigger records fired for one attack from one source holding as many instances of battle cry, one record per instance.
near_miss: One battle cry trigger record fired for the attack from a source holding a single instance.
record_fields: the acting line, the keyword's own sidecar line (api Keyword)
the source entity's instances of the keyword in the trigger record's snapshot (printed keyword lines, granted_attached, granted_temporary.keywords)
